sourceText:
Berry Tiramisu
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 5:31am

Ingredients




1 cup Fresh raspberries
1 cup Fresh blueberries
1 cup Fresh blackberries
1 cup Sliced strawberries
1 cup Sugar
Juice of one lemon
2 pints Heavy cream
8 ounces Mascarpone cheese
cup Powdered sugar
1 Prepared sponge cake - (9" by 9" by 2") sliced into 3 layers
1 cup Chambord liqueur
cup Raspberry coulis
Fresh mint sprigs
Powdered sugar in shaker

Preparation

1 In a mixing bowl, combine all the berries with the sugar and lemon juice. With a fork, lightly mash 1/4 of the berries against the side of the bowl. Allow the berries to sit for 1 hour. 2 Using an electric mixer, whip the cream until stiff peaks form. In a mixing bowl, fold half of the whipped cream into the Mascarpone cheese, along with the powdered sugar. Blend until the cream is fully incorporated. 3 To assemble, lay one layer of the sponge cake on the bottom of the pan. Brush the layer with the Chambord. Spread 1/3 of the cheese mixture over the sponge cake. Repeat the procedure until all of the cake and cheese mixture are used. Spread the reserved whipped cream over the top of the cake. Allow the cake to set, about 1 hour. 4 Place a slice of the tirmisu on the plate. Garnish with raspberry coulis, fresh mint and powdered sugar. 5 This recipe yields 12 servings.  6 Serve and enjoy :)
